link83.observation: The exact key 55 -> 56 transition completes. One collection occurs after key 56 is delivered and before key 57 is requested.

v1.2.5.observation: The predecessor also completes the exact key 55 -> 56 transition under its own generated editor image and target heap geometry.

hardware_evidence_limit.captured: The device displayed and persisted 55 keys; the 56th had no visible acknowledgement for 120 seconds; RUN/STOP restored a live REPL; final mem_oom was zero.
missing_at_stall: gc_runs before and during the stalled key
hardware_evidence_limit.reason_gc_is_not_attributed: The hardware receipt captured gc_runs only after abort and later independent rows. The host collection at key 56 is therefore a named correlation, not a target mechanism claim.

stalled_capture: $D619 PETSCII head (read only; only the product write dequeues)

outcomes.A: $D60A bit 7 set with $D619=$61: key reached the hardware queue but the product did not consume it.
outcomes.B: queue empty, gc_runs advanced, PC inside $38F7..$3EC1: key was consumed and target GC completion is the mechanism.
outcomes.C: queue empty, gc_runs advanced, PC outside gc_collect: key was consumed and the stall is post-GC in step/render/persist.
outcomes.D: queue empty and gc_runs unchanged: virtual-key delivery is unproved or execution stopped before the host-predicted collection; the PC names which side.
